title: Tile Stack: Can You Beat Lv.2?
description: Easy to learn on Stage 1, devilishly layered from Stage 2 onward — clear the strawberry hamster's stacked farm tiles using Undo, Pop-out and Shuffle.
controls: Tap unblocked tiles into the 7-slot tray to clear triples. Save Undo, Pop-out and Shuffle for tight layers.

zh-CN.title: 叠叠消：第2关算你狠
zh-CN.description: 草莓仓鼠喊你来破关！第 1 关三秒学会，第 2 关起层层叠叠暗藏杀机——到底能闯到第几关？移出、撤回、洗牌三大法宝全给你配齐了。
zh-CN.controls: 点击亮起的可选卡牌放进底部 7 格槽，凑齐 3 张同图案消除；卡壳别慌，底部移出、撤回、洗牌随便秀操作！
